description: Source code implementing SIMD-accelerated Poly1305 MAC algorithm with vectorization, including initialization, update, and finish functions, using SSE2 intrinsics and specific internal data structures.

methods.name: CRYPTO_poly1305_init
methods.description: Initializes the Poly1305 state with a 32-byte key, setting up internal parameters and zeroing the state.

methods.name: CRYPTO_poly1305_update
methods.description: Processes input data in chunks, updating the internal state with SIMD-accelerated computations.

methods.name: CRYPTO_poly1305_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the MAC computation, performs modular reduction, and outputs the 16-byte tag.
